$description: Prisme color tokens — the single source of truth for web (global.css imports the generated src/tokens.css) and mobile (the generated src/tokens.ts palettes). Linear-like: monochrome chrome, hairlines, and color reserved for what it means (the three Leanings). Light and dark both follow the system. Rationale lives here, not in the generated files.

prose.$description: Long-form prose (static pages): one step below ink, so reading text stays clearly apart from chrome (muted) without full-ink starkness across long paragraphs.

centre.$description: Centre Coverage group. Lightness architecture: the centre gold is clearly lighter than the two darker ends, so adjacent segments separate at any bar height. Only the three group colors exist: a Leaning dot is colored by its Coverage group, its label carries the granular band.

onLeaning.$description: Active tab label on the saturated Leaning pills (light theme).

toggleTrack.$description: The reading toggle's track (issue #89, Primer SegmentedControl): a flat, solid gray — quiet, but enough for the knob to read against.

trending.$description: The one color outside the Leaning palette: the Trending Story badge (« Faits nouveaux », ADR-0014). Sarcelle is calm but unmistakably set apart from rouge, or and droite. Light theme darkens it for readability on the near-white canvas.

dark.$description: Dark theme — the prefers-color-scheme: dark palette.

gauche.$description: Left Coverage group, pastel on the dark canvas.

onLeaning.$description: Active tab label on the pastel Leaning pills: dark text for contrast (white on these pastels fails WCAG 4.5:1 badly).

trending.$description: Trending Story badge (ADR-0014), vivid on the dark canvas.
